classscheduling.title: Class Scheduling
classscheduling.subtitle: Scheduling system for a school.
classscheduling.description: Created of the zero absolute, this site allows logged-in users to create and manage their appointments. The system includes a REST API, Swagger documentation, database integration, encryption, unit and integration tests, and email sending functionality.

barbabrutal.title: Barbabrutal
barbabrutal.subtitle: Barbershop appointments made easy.
barbabrutal.description: A barbershop scheduling system that allows the user to make and manage their appointments after logging in, this system has REST API, database and encryption

gamerstore.title: GamerStore
gamerstore.subtitle: Online store for gamer products.
gamerstore.description: This system allows the user to view the products listed by the API, see the products in the shopping cart, and view their orders stored in the browser's localStorage.

weather.title: Weather Project
weather.subtitle: Current weather conditions in any city worldwide.
weather.description: This project consumes the Open Weather API to display current weather conditions. The site automatically changes to Snow Mode, Cloud Mode, or Summer Mode based on the searched city's temperature.

movies.title: Buscador de Filmes
movies.subtitle: Discover movies in theaters and save your favorites.
movies.description: This project uses TheMovieDB API to list trending movies and allows users to search the catalog. Features include saving to favorites and watching trailers on YouTube.
